subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 10=5 The nature of a mother’s love is the same in all countries. It is (a) ____ (universe) ____. For our (b) ____ (exist) ____ on earth, we (c) ____ (great) ____ owe to our father and mother, (d) ____ (special) ____ to our mother. A mother’s love is (e) ____ (parallel) ____ and unique. A child’s (f) ____(relate) ____ with its mother is (g) ____ (heaven) ____ and (h) ____ (spirit) ____ .We can (i) ____ (hard) ____ see a mother (j) ____ (different) ____ to her child’s wellbeing.
guide_solution: (a) universal (b) existence (c) greatly (d) specially (e) unparallel (f) relation (g) heavenly (h) spiritual (i) hardly (j) indifferent
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Dinajpur Board-2022 (Board Question With Solution)
